title: Departure Rollovers and Milk Bought on Its Own: School Nutrition Services Meal Account Questions Answered
content:
A departure rollover to a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts milk bought on its own by how many times it was rung up on the account in the month before the rollover date: four (4) or more purchases make a regular buyer, and the milk-only price is added to every serving day counted; one to three purchases add once what the student spent on it in that month; no purchase adds nothing.

A date falls within the N months before the rollover date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the rollover date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

## Basis questions

**Is a student with exactly four purchases a regular buyer?** Yes; four or more purchases make a regular buyer.

**What is added for a student with three purchases?** Once, what the student spent on them in that month.

**And with no purchase in that month?** Nothing.

| Times milk bought on its own was rung up in the month before the rollover date | What is added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | the milk-only price (0.75) for every serving day counted |
| 1, 2 or 3 | what the student spent on it in that month, once |
| 0 | nothing |
